desc.p: Deletes the account of the user the Access Token belongs to, by the site's own rules, as its terms promise when a user ends the agreement:

ul.li: An account without geocaches, logs or reports is deleted completely.

Any other account is anonymized, as the site's team does it on a deletion request: the personal data (name, email address, password, profile, home coordinates, lists, watches, personal notes, sessions) is deleted; the user's geocaches are locked and their listings neutralized; the texts of the user's logs are replaced and the pictures of the user's geocaches and logs deleted. The logs themselves, the geocaches' positions and ratings stay, so the game's history stays intact for others. The username becomes delete_<id>.

desc.p: This can't be undone. All Access Tokens of the user end with it, this one too.

The request needs the account's password, so a stored Access Token alone is not enough. Only for applications the site's administrators allowed to register users (an application that creates accounts has to offer their deletion too), and only over HTTPS. Available where has_registration in services/apisrv/installation is true.
A wrong password gives HTTP 400 with the reason wrong_password.

ul.li: result - deleted (the account is gone) or anonymized (see above).
